subject: math
document: The Ontario Curriculum, Grades 1 to 8: Mathematics (2020)
checkedBy: Opus build session, against the official PDF: The Ontario Curriculum, Grades 1 to 8, Mathematics, 2020 (version history to February 2024), downloaded from the Ministry site on 2026-10-12. Every code and number range here matches the Grade 1 specific expectations word for word.
partial: Grade 1 math as far as release one goes: number, facts, patterns, sorting, measuring and money. Ordering, estimating and adding to 50 come later.

expectations.label: Read and show numbers up to 50
expectations.note: Paraphrase. The official wording is at sourceUrl. Shown as tens and ones.

expectations.label: Count to 50 by 1s, 2s, 5s and 10s
expectations.note: Paraphrase. The official wording is at sourceUrl.

expectations.label: Compare whole numbers up to 50
expectations.note: Paraphrase. The official wording is at sourceUrl. Ordering comes later.

expectations.label: Know adding facts up to 10 and the take-away facts that match them
expectations.note: Paraphrase. The official wording is at sourceUrl. Read as sums up to 10 and their matching subtractions.

expectations.label: Use a pattern's rule to carry it on and find a missing piece
expectations.note: Paraphrase. The official wording is at sourceUrl.

expectations.label: Sort shapes and solid objects by one thing they share
expectations.note: Paraphrase. The official wording is at sourceUrl. Rules used: solid or flat, four sides, rolls or does not roll.

expectations.label: Compare everyday things by length, weight and how much they hold
expectations.note: Paraphrase. The official wording is at sourceUrl. Comparing two at a time; ordering several comes later.

expectations.label: Know Canadian coins and bills, and which is worth more
expectations.note: Paraphrase. The official wording is at sourceUrl. Coins up to the toonie and bills up to $50. The 50-cent coin and the penny are left out because neither turns up in change.
